title: Annual Reduction for Wear on a Piece Covered by the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
The figure standing for a repair under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is reduced for each whole year the piece has been worn, and the rate at which that reduction is taken turns on what the most recent inspection recorded and on whether the work order carrying the claim's reference, raised with the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service, records a rework.

Where the most recent inspection entry on the plan records the piece as sound and that work order records no rework, the annual reduction is taken at the sound-piece share, being 0.5 of the rate the coverage publishes. Where the most recent inspection entry records the piece as referred to the bench, or that work order records a rework, the annual reduction is taken at the worn-piece share, being 1.5 of the rate the coverage publishes. In any other case the annual reduction is taken at the rate the coverage publishes.

## The rate the coverage publishes

| Plan | Annual reduction published |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 10.0 percent |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 8.0 percent |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 6.0 percent |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 4.0 percent |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 0.0 percent |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 0.0 percent |

## The three readings

| Most recent inspection entry | Rework on the work order | Rate at which the annual reduction is taken |
|---|---|---|
| the piece recorded as sound | none recorded | 0.5 of the published rate |
| the piece recorded as referred to the bench | any | 1.5 of the published rate |
| any standing | a rework recorded | 1.5 of the published rate |
| any other case | | the published rate |

## Worked readings

On a plan publishing 6.0 percent a year, a piece recorded sound at its last inspection with no rework on the order is reduced at 3.0 percent for each whole year worn; the same piece referred to the bench at that inspection is reduced at 9.0 percent for each whole year worn. On the two plans publishing 0.0 percent, every reading leaves the rate at nothing.
